BPM_ENGINE.description: Activiti/Flowable business-process-engine tables (ACT_* prefix). Engine-internal runtime, history and identity state. Not application business data.

CORE_MASTER.description: Cross-cutting master data referenced by most other modules (company, currency, country, division, unit of measure, item type, counters).

COSTING.description: Cost calculation, cost routes, cost consumption and accounting-derived costs.

EINVOICING.description: Electronic invoicing documents and transmission state.

FINANCE.description: Financial accounting: vouchers, open items, GL, assets, loans, expense notes, allocations.

HR.description: Human resources: employees, recruitment, attendance, leave, payroll.

INTERNAL_ORDERS.description: Internal orders, internal documents, internal price lists and assortments.

INTRASTAT.description: Intrastat / intra-community trade declaration reference data.

INVENTORY.description: Stock transactions, stock takes, balances and transaction templates.

ITEM_MASTER.description: Item/product master data, bills of material, sizes, compositions, specialisations.

LOCALIZATION.description: Country/region-specific extensions (USA*, NET* prefixes) such as localized accounting journals, credit checks and GST tax mapping. Grouping is inferred and uncertain.

LOGISTICS.description: Logistics documents and partners (LOG* prefix): internal documents/orders, order partners, addresses, products, warehouse movements.

OTHER.description: No confident module assignment from naming conventions.

PDM.description: Product data management tables (PDM* prefix). Terse legacy naming (PDMDB1H, PDMSUP0); meaning not derivable from the DDL alone.

PLATFORM.description: Application framework layer (ABS* prefix): UI XML definitions, languages and translations, batch queues, spool files, locks, user constants, installed module versions. Infrastructure, not business data.

PRODUCTION.description: Production orders, routings, work centres, steps and progress.

PURCHASING.description: Purchase orders, purchase documents, purchase pricing and discounts.

QUALITY.description: Quality control: inspections, measurements, elements, results.

SALES.description: Sales orders, sales documents, sales lines, pricing and related detail.

SCHEDULING.description: Advanced production scheduling subsystem. Evidence: capacity resources (CAPRES), alternative work centres (ALT_WKC), calendars, machine setup codes, auto-scheduling configuration. SCDA_/SCDM_/SCDC_ are three co-operating variants of the same model.

SPECIFICATIONS.description: Specification masters, templates, groups and lines (MSE* prefix); supplier and stock/service specification checks.

SUBCONTRACTING.description: External operations: subcontracted operation documents, lines, prices, charges and discounts.

TNA.description: TNA* tables: activities, results, linked entities, authorisation rules, e-mail setup. Expansion of the acronym is NOT determinable from this DDL -- treat the module label as opaque.

WAREHOUSE.description: Warehouse and logical-warehouse definitions, capacity and locations.

WORK_DOCUMENTS.description: Working/transient document area (WRK* prefix): document print runs, claims, comments, product-cost calculation detail. Typically populated per processing run.
